race.comment: CHILLCUZ (1) was well supported fresh and never gave in but just failed to reel in the last few, only beaten 1.2L in fifth. Fitter and will appreciate the rise to a trip she's won twice over. Should be blending into it beautifully from her draw. ROYAL SCRIPTURE (2) was much better last start at headquarters when beaten less than a length by Justacclaim who has since won again on Saturday. Form reads well and gets 2kgs off with the claim. Can give this a big shake. VICTORY QUEEN (6) has mixed her form since resuming but was back near her best last start at Naracoorte when getting the job done in testing conditions. Draws the A1 for Callow and is one of the key chances. KISS AND KABOOM (8) produced her best run of the prep last time when chasing gamely into the placings. Drawn to get back but should be hitting her straps now and the rise to 1400m should suit. UNWIND (10) has been warming nicely late at the end of her races. If the pace is genuine she can pounce on them late.
